verdict.rationale: Searching across tasks, docs, and comments is a fair capability to ask of a project-tracking tool like Shortcut, but nothing in the evidence pack documents any search feature: no search UI, search API endpoint, or coverage of docs and comments. The 'quick load times' claim describes general app speed rather than search, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
